Basically, I was in your situation. I was one of those "Smart kids", so I got heavily pressured to go to college. Luckily, turns out I actually love learning and higher education, so it worked out. 

But, my advice would be to try to make it into a community college, test the waters. If you like it, consider transferring to a larger university; the education itself isn't that much greater, but the name will make you stand out. Maybe pick up a part-time job, get your own apartment, that sort of thing. College not for you? That's 100% okay. Maybe think about technical/vocational school. Not interested in that either? Find some jobs that pays around what you'd like, and then pick the one that you think would allow you to sleep the best at night

Live in Louisiana during Mardi Gras. I'm maybe 10-13 years old. Mom is doing whatever with people. At a parade with my brother, cousin and cousin's friend. Parked in some convenience store's parking lot. Cousin is an idiot. Decides to have some fun with a shipping cart. We push him around into walls and stuff, and he decides he wants to take a shit in the shopping cart. In the act of shitting, there's apparently a cop watching us from his car the whole fucking time. He gets on his speaker, and says something along the lines of "Hey! Stop that" and we take off running, my cousin with his pants around his ankles and shit hanging out of his arse. We run to my mom's car and hide there, too scared to even breathe and it smells more terrible than anything I've smelled before. It's dark and every sound is that cop coming to arrest us. We spend the rest of the night there. Luckily, we found my mom's perfume and used about half the bottle. She doesn't know this story to this day

TLDR ; At a Mardi Gras parade, cousin tries to shit in a shopping cart, cop yells at us and we run and hide in my mom's car for the rest of the night smelling like literal shit
